arguments.heading: What happened at the argument
paragraphs: The operator argued that expanding the public function test would radically change existing law.
The residents argued that the operator was engaged by the city to administer a state-determined scheme.
Justice Sotomayor noted that government often has its own speech and creates speech.
Justice Ginsburg described the operator as administering a first-come, first-served access scheme.
